entities.name: Farrelites
entities.description: A zealous breakaway religious sect in Sarpadia founded by Oliver Farrel, concentrated in Montford.

entities.name: Oliver Farrel
entities.description: Founder of the Farrelites, a former Icatian priest who is killed by Tev Loneglade.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: Nation where the Farrelites were found.

entities.name: Montford
entities.description: City where the Farrelites were concentrated.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: Sister of Tev, killed by Farrel after refusing him.

entities.name: Tev Loneglade
entities.description: A planeswalker, brother of Tymolin, who incinerates the Farrelites and the Ebon Hand as Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Vaylesh
entities.description: Leader of the Ebon Hand party that captured Tymolin.

entities.name: Tourach
entities.description: Figure Farrelites accused people of serving.

entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: Place where Tev found himself lost.

entities.name: Trokair
entities.description: Icatian city whose fall led the Farrelites to break ties with Icatia.

entities.name: Thrull Rebellion
entities.description: Rebellion that swept Sarpadia soon after Farrel's death.

events.summary: Oliver Farrel breaks from the Order of Leitbur, gathering followers with speeches against the Icatian government.
events.quote: Farrel gathered many followers through impassioned speeches on the street

events.summary: When Trokair falls, the Farrelites break ties with Icatia and turn hostile.
events.quote: When Trokair fell, the Farrelites broke all ties with Icatia and became openly hostile.

events.summary: Farrel ambushes Tymolin and Tev; Tev dispels the mantle from Sianna and is then lost in Havenwood, letting Tymolin be captured.
events.quote: Tev dispelled the mantle from Sianna, defeating and angering Farrel

events.summary: Farrel kills Tymolin after she refuses to be his champion and lover.
events.quote: Farrel killed her, sending Tev into a rage.

events.summary: Tev arrives as Tevesh Szat and incinerates the Farrelites and Ebon Hand, killing Farrel and Sianna.
events.quote: incinerating all present, including Farrel and Sianna

relations.quote: Farrel killed her, sending Tev into a rage.
incinerating all present, including Farrel and Sianna
her brother, the planeswalker Tev Loneglade
